name: Greater Thunderstone
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning + 2.5 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 2.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 6 blocks within 1 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 9 s
• Slowness II for 7 s
